chapters.title: On-Chain Referral Systems
chapters.content:
### On-Chain Referral Systems

A referral system is simply a way to track and rewards who is brining who in a network. Web3 enables on-chain referral systems to be trasnparent and who is onboarding who, but also to automatically program the payouts. This on-chain nature of referrals allow anyone to develop a web of trust from an on-chain referral system, develop complex points, for how onboaridng in an ecosystem works, incorporate slashing an automate funding / rewards based on this dependency graph. This type of dependecy graph structure is the case for a mechanism like [Drips.network](http://Drips.network) which rewards down the dependcy tree for projects in funding.

Widely available on chain referral systems are still in its infancy. In the Solana Space their is Buddy Link, which is…

- Informal systems: seeing which accounts funded which for onboarding on to a blockchain.

Referral Systems tools inn Web3

Privacy concerns, ux for the actual activity and ingratiating that into the flow

Considerations & Tradeoffs
  • reliant on humans to prove. Need an on-chain capture of that interaction to audit later.
  • Must map who onboarded who or it will be difficult to map or incentivize individuals to onboard.
  • Must incorporate with individuals being able to do the task and multipliers for group work (how to tag multiple people)
  • Must have a way to proof the activity for existing members. Cannot just be initial onboarding.

Maturity of a Proofing Mechanism

  • Can easily tag or sign from existing members wallets
  • Checks other account for membership
  • Once something is approved then someone is automatically a member and clearly directed to
  • Automatic proposal of member in new DAO role
  • Can attribute to an event or something done by DAO

Funding Mechanism

as more proofs happen natural demand side to fund more events as it proves on chain interactions.
  • Funding should be built into the governance systems at a certian maturity. As well as reputation system that helps quanitfy the proofing mechanisms.
  • Example people with x amount of reputaiton points from governance.

chapters.title: Governance Mechanism
chapters.content:
### Governance Mechanism Governance is tricky but essentially they are shared wallets, and how you share the wallet or how decisions are made can directly pool into other funding mechanisms. Addtionally an overall treasury can allocate different funding pools for different funding mechanism to create more plural incentive mechanisms based on different stakeholders

Ex;

- members: general DAO, may just be used for member sentiment - Active members / core team: core team can have their main DAO or main capital allicators to sub-business units - Funders: people who contribute can have their own DAO that represents ownerships

Balancing governance between

  • governance can include how slashing works with in proof system

Most difficult is finding balance from members

  • rewarding quality governance
  • having a person their to asses contribution
For details on different funding mechanisms check out [mechanism.institute](http://mechanism.institute) and the [Allocation Book](https://allobook.gitcoin.co/)
